approved_slide.file: 60. Field Permit to Work Agent one-pager.pptx

findings: New wave-2 template distilled from a recurring field workflow pattern; no prior library source existed.
The field pattern relied on live systems, runtime clocks, model calls and free-text inputs that cannot be reviewed deterministically.
The field pattern included steps that would change records or notify people if run against live systems.

Version 1.1.0 audit against an internal use-case outline for permit to work found four missing steps: the work request completeness check, the control room isolation confirmation, the crew's on-site acceptance, and the archived audit trail.
fixes: Rebuilt the workflow as a single stdlib-only agent over a fixed fictional snapshot with invented organizations, people, records and values.
Exposed 11 deterministic operations, one per story turn, with enum or name-resolver inputs and a not-found miss instead of free text.
Converted every write, send, approval or notification step into a draft, check or recommendation with an explicit human gate.
Added one locked persona-language case and one uploadable skill per operation, plus two synthetic knowledge files.
Version 1.1.0 added work_request_check, isolation_confirmation, acceptance_readiness and audit_trail over separate fictional records; the 7 original operations return byte-identical output.
remaining_boundary: Production connections and all external actions require customer approval, least-privilege controls, and an authorized human workflow.
